export default "---\ntitle: Row Nodes\ndescription: Complete reference for the RowNode interface covering data rows, group rows, pinned rows, and row-level metadata.\n---\n\nEvery row in a GridStorm grid is represented by a `RowNode<TData>` object. Row nodes wrap your data objects with metadata needed for rendering, selection, grouping, aggregation, and virtual scrolling.\n\n```ts title=\"RowNode<TData>\"\ninterface RowNode<TData = any> {\n  id: string;\n  data: TData | undefined;\n  sourceIndex: number;\n  displayIndex: number;\n  level: number;\n  rowHeight: number;\n  rowTop: number;\n  parent: RowNode<TData> | null;\n  children: RowNode<TData>[] | null;\n  expanded: boolean;\n  group: boolean;\n  groupField: string | null;\n  groupValue: any;\n  leafChildrenCount: number;\n  aggData: Record<string, any> | null;\n  selected: boolean;\n  selectable: boolean;\n  detail: boolean;\n  rowPinned: 'top' | 'bottom' | null;\n  version: number;\n}\n```\n\n## Identity Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `id` | `string` | Unique row identifier. Generated by `GridConfig.getRowId` or defaults to the array index. Used as the key in `GridState.rowNodes` and for selection tracking. |\n| `data` | `TData \\| undefined` | Reference to the original row data object. `undefined` for group rows, filler rows, and loading placeholder rows. |\n| `sourceIndex` | `number` | Index in the original (unfiltered, unsorted) data array. `-1` for group rows and other synthetic nodes. |\n| `displayIndex` | `number` | Index in the displayed (post-filter/sort/group/pagination) row list. Corresponds to the visual position in the grid. Used by the virtual scroller. |\n\n## Nesting\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `level` | `number` | Nesting depth for tree/group data. `0` for top-level rows. Incremented by 1 for each grouping level. |\n\n## Display Geometry\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `rowHeight` | `number` | Height of this row in pixels, as resolved from `GridConfig.rowHeight`. |\n| `rowTop` | `number` | Vertical offset in pixels from the top of the virtual scroll container. Used by the virtual scroller to position row elements via CSS `transform`. |\n\n## Tree and Group Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `parent` | `RowNode<TData> \\| null` | Parent group node. `null` for top-level rows. |\n| `children` | `RowNode<TData>[] \\| null` | Child row nodes when this is a group row. `null` for leaf (non-group) rows. |\n| `expanded` | `boolean` | Whether this group row is currently expanded (children visible). Always `false` for non-group rows. Default: `false`. |\n| `group` | `boolean` | `true` if this node represents a group row rather than a data row. Group rows are created by the grouping plugin. |\n| `groupField` | `string \\| null` | The column field that this group row represents. `null` for non-group rows. |\n| `groupValue` | `any` | The grouping value for this group row (e.g., the department name). `undefined` for non-group rows. |\n| `leafChildrenCount` | `number` | Total number of leaf (non-group) descendant rows under this group. `0` for non-group rows. |\n\n## Aggregation Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `aggData` | `Record<string, any> \\| null` | Aggregated data for group rows, keyed by column ID. Populated by the aggregation plugin when `ColumnDef.aggFunc` is configured. `null` when no aggregation is active or for non-group rows. |\n\n```ts title=\"Aggregation data\"\n// For a group row with aggFunc: 'sum' on salary, aggFunc: 'avg' on age:\nnode.aggData // { salary: 450000, age: 32.5 }\n```\n\n## Selection Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `selected` | `boolean` | Whether this row is currently selected. |\n| `selectable` | `boolean` | Whether this row can be selected. Set to `false` to prevent selection of specific rows. Default: `true`. |\n\n## Detail Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `detail` | `boolean` | `true` if this is a detail row in a master-detail layout. Detail rows expand below their master row and can contain nested grids or custom content. |\n\n## Pinning Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `rowPinned` | `'top' \\| 'bottom' \\| null` | Indicates whether this row is pinned. `'top'` from `GridConfig.pinnedTopRowData`, `'bottom'` from `GridConfig.pinnedBottomRowData`, `null` for normal scrolling rows. |\n\n## Version Tracking\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `version` | `number` | Incremented each time the node's properties change. Used by the renderer for targeted re-renders. Comparing versions is cheaper than deep equality checks on the entire node. |\n\n## Row Types\n\n### Data Rows\n\nStandard rows that hold your data objects:\n\n```ts title=\"Data row characteristics\"\nnode.group === false\nnode.data !== undefined\nnode.children === null\nnode.rowPinned === null\n```\n\n### Group Rows\n\nCreated by the grouping plugin when `ColumnDef.rowGroup` is enabled:\n\n```ts title=\"Group row characteristics\"\nnode.group === true\nnode.data === undefined\nnode.children !== null      // array of child RowNodes\nnode.groupField === 'department'\nnode.groupValue === 'Engineering'\nnode.leafChildrenCount === 15\nnode.expanded === true      // or false\n```\n\n### Pinned Rows\n\nCreated from `pinnedTopRowData` or `pinnedBottomRowData`. Excluded from sorting, filtering, and pagination:\n\n```ts title=\"Pinned row characteristics\"\nnode.rowPinned === 'top'    // or 'bottom'\nnode.data !== undefined     // holds the pinned row data\n```\n\n### Detail Rows\n\nUsed in master-detail layouts for expandable sub-content:\n\n```ts title=\"Detail row characteristics\"\nnode.detail === true\n```\n\n## Accessing Row Nodes\n\n### By ID\n\n```ts title=\"getRowNode\"\nconst node = api.getRowNode('emp-123');\nif (node) {\n  console.log(node.data?.name, node.selected);\n}\n```\n\n### By Display Index\n\n```ts title=\"getDisplayedRowAtIndex\"\nconst firstRow = api.getDisplayedRowAtIndex(0);\nconst lastRow = api.getDisplayedRowAtIndex(api.getDisplayedRowCount() - 1);\n```\n\n### Iterating All Nodes\n\n```ts title=\"forEachNode\"\napi.forEachNode((node, index) => {\n  if (node.selected) {\n    console.log('Selected:', node.id, node.data?.name);\n  }\n});\n```\n\n### From Selected Rows\n\n```ts title=\"getSelectedNodes\"\nconst selectedNodes = api.getSelectedNodes();\nconst selectedData = api.getSelectedRows(); // returns TData[]\n```\n\n### From Grid State\n\n```ts title=\"Grid state collections\"\nconst state = api.getState();\nconst totalNodes = state.rowNodes.size;           // Map<string, RowNode>\nconst displayedCount = state.displayedRowIds.length; // string[]\n\n// Look up a specific node from state\nconst node = state.rowNodes.get('emp-123');\n```\n\n## Row Node Events\n\nMany grid events include the affected row node in their payload. Subscribe via `api.addEventListener`.\n\n| Event | Payload Fields | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `row:clicked` | `{ node, event }` | Fired when a row is clicked. |\n| `row:doubleClicked` | `{ node, event }` | Fired when a row is double-clicked. |\n| `cell:clicked` | `{ node, colId, value, event }` | Fired when a cell is clicked. |\n| `cell:doubleClicked` | `{ node, colId, value, event }` | Fired when a cell is double-clicked. |\n| `cell:editingStarted` | `{ node, colId, value }` | Fired when a cell enters edit mode. |\n| `cell:editingStopped` | `{ node, colId, oldValue, newValue, cancelled }` | Fired when editing completes or is cancelled. |\n| `cell:valueChanged` | `{ node, colId, oldValue, newValue }` | Fired after a cell value is committed. |\n| `row:groupOpened` | `{ node, expanded }` | Fired when a group row is expanded or collapsed. |\n| `rowNode:updated` | `{ node }` | Fired when a row node's properties are updated. |\n| `selection:changed` | `{ selectedNodes, source }` | Fired when selected rows change. |\n| `row:moved` | `{ rowId, fromIndex, toIndex }` | Fired when a row is moved to a new position. |\n\n```ts title=\"Row node events\"\napi.addEventListener('cell:clicked', (event) => {\n  console.log('Clicked row:', event.node.id, 'column:', event.colId);\n});\n\napi.addEventListener('row:groupOpened', (event) => {\n  console.log('Group', event.node.groupValue, 'expanded:', event.expanded);\n});\n\napi.addEventListener('cell:valueChanged', (event) => {\n  console.log('Row', event.node.id, 'changed:', event.oldValue, '->', event.newValue);\n});\n```\n\n## Row Node Lifecycle\n\nRow nodes go through several stages during their lifetime in the grid:\n\n### 1. Creation\n\nRow nodes are created when data is provided to the grid via `GridConfig.rowData`, `api.setRowData()`, or `api.addRows()`. The grid engine calls `createRowNodes()` which:\n\n- Assigns each node a unique `id` (from `getRowId` or array index)\n- Sets `sourceIndex` to the position in the input array\n- Sets `rowHeight` from `GridConfig.rowHeight`\n- Initializes `version` to `0`\n\n### 2. Processing\n\nAfter creation, the row processing pipeline runs:\n\n1. **Filtering** -- Nodes not matching the filter model or quick filter are excluded from display.\n2. **Sorting** -- Remaining nodes are sorted according to the sort model.\n3. **Grouping** -- If grouping is active, group nodes are created and data nodes are nested under them.\n4. **Display assignment** -- Each visible node receives a `displayIndex` and `rowTop` value.\n\n### 3. Mutation\n\nRow nodes use a mutable internal design for performance. Properties that change at runtime:\n\n| Property | Changed By | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `selected` | Selection plugin | Updated when rows are selected or deselected. |\n| `expanded` | Grouping plugin / API | Updated when group rows are expanded or collapsed. |\n| `displayIndex` | Row processing pipeline | Reassigned after sort, filter, or group changes. |\n| `rowTop` | Row processing pipeline | Recalculated based on display position and row heights. |\n| `aggData` | Aggregation plugin | Recomputed when group membership or values change. |\n| `version` | Any mutation | Incremented after any property change to signal the renderer. |\n\n### 4. Update\n\nTo update a cell value, use the transaction API or direct mutation:\n\n```ts title=\"Transaction update\"\napi.updateRows([\n  { id: 'emp-123', data: { salary: 95000 } },\n]);\n```\n\n```ts title=\"Direct mutation\"\nconst node = api.getRowNode('emp-123');\nif (node?.data) {\n  node.data.salary = 95000;\n  node.version++;\n  api.refreshCells({ rowIds: ['emp-123'], colIds: ['salary'] });\n}\n```\n\n:::caution\nDirect mutation bypasses the command bus and event system. For tracked, auditable changes, use `api.updateRows()` or the editing system instead.\n:::\n\n### 5. Removal\n\nNodes are removed via `api.removeRows()` or replaced entirely via `api.setRowData()`. Removed nodes are deleted from `GridState.rowNodes` and from the selection set.\n\n```ts title=\"Removing rows\"\napi.removeRows(['emp-123', 'emp-456']);\n```\n\n## GridState Row Collections\n\nThe grid state contains two row-related collections:\n\n| Collection | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `rowNodes` | `Map<string, RowNode<TData>>` | All row nodes keyed by ID. Includes data rows, group rows, and pinned rows. |\n| `displayedRowIds` | `string[]` | Ordered array of row IDs currently visible after filter, sort, group, and pagination. |\n\n```ts title=\"Accessing state collections\"\nconst state = api.getState();\n\n// All nodes\nfor (const [id, node] of state.rowNodes) {\n  console.log(id, node.group ? 'group' : 'data');\n}\n\n// Displayed nodes in order\nfor (const id of state.displayedRowIds) {\n  const node = state.rowNodes.get(id);\n  console.log(node?.displayIndex, node?.data);\n}\n```\n\n## Related Types\n\n### GetRowIdParams\n\n```ts title=\"GetRowIdParams\"\ninterface GetRowIdParams<TData> {\n  data: TData;           // The row data object\n  index: number;         // Zero-based index in the input data array\n  parentKeys?: string[]; // Parent group keys for grouped/tree data\n}\n```\n\n### RowModelType\n\n```ts title=\"RowModelType\"\ntype RowModelType = 'client' | 'server' | 'infinite' | 'viewport';\n```\n\n### SelectionSource\n\n```ts title=\"SelectionSource\"\ntype SelectionSource = 'api' | 'checkbox' | 'click' | 'keyboard' | 'selectAll';\n```\n"
